description.fun: A chunky baby dragon with a triangular fin on its back that soaks up heat and turns it into ice energy, so the hotter it gets, the more it stores. It uses that energy to keep its nest cool like a refrigerator, and picks a fight with Bergmite whenever they meet. Its look may borrow from Concavenator, a dinosaur whose back crest may have helped it control its temperature.
description.guide: A Dragon and Ice-type Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet. Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts it into ice energy. It evolves into Arctibax and then Baxcalibur.
description.tagline: A baby ice dragon with a built-in refrigerator fin

description.fun: Arctibax freezes the air around itself, wearing an ice mask over its face (the bits over its eyes look like eyebrows) and turning its back fin into a blade of ice. Its strong back and legs let it do a front flip mid-fight and slash with the frozen fin. It's rarely found in the wild, turning up only in certain caverns.
description.guide: The middle stage of Frigibax's line, a Dragon and Ice-type Pokémon that protects its face with an ice mask and turns its dorsal fin into an icy blade. It evolves into Baxcalibur.
description.tagline: An ice-masked dragon that front-flips into a fin slash

description.fun: A towering ice dragon whose breath is cold enough to freeze lava. In battle it flips upside down onto its head and forelimbs and blasts its frigid breath to launch itself, sail first, at its foe. Its upright stance may nod to kaiju played by actors in suits, and it evolves at level 54, perhaps for 1954, the year Godzilla came out.
description.guide: The final evolution of Frigibax, a Dragon and Ice-type Pokémon that breathes air cold enough to freeze lava and attacks with its blade-like dorsal sail. Its name combines 'back' and Excalibur. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Baxcalibur in the Mega Dimension DLC for Pokémon Legends: Z-A.
description.tagline: An upside-down kaiju dragon with breath that freezes lava

description.fun: Mega Evolution grows its back sail into a giant sword, fused at the front to an icy hilt over its solar plexus that fires beams. Ice energy floods its whole body, even turning its pupils red.
